snippet.title: White Knuckle | Parasite Trailer
snippet.description:
The Parasite update for White Knuckle is coming.

Prepare to explore a new map, brave new enemies, and do your best to stave off the creeping Infection. Use the all-new scanner to search for helpful items like power cells, pipe wrenches, and infection injectors to survive and escape. 

Store page: https://dreadxp.games/WK

Follow the dev: https://bsky.app/profile/jonka.bsky.social

Join the community: https://discord.gg/PX25QrbGrw
